scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @spendlens/api" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @spendlens/api
scripts.build:static: npm run build:browser -w @spendlens/api && npm run build -w web -- --configuration production,static
scripts.start:static: npm run build:browser -w @spendlens/api && npm run start -w web -- --configuration static
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/contracts --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm test -w @spendlens/contracts && npm test -w @spendlens/api && npm test -w web -- --watch=false
